name: Easy Vegan Dutch Oven Tempeh, Mushroom & Bell Pepper Chili with Guacamole

instructions.primary_message: Place water in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, add dried shiitake mushrooms, and set aside to rehydrate, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup water
1 oz dried shitake mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Once hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sliced white mushrooms and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 (8 oz) pkg sliced white mushrooms
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the white mushrooms are cooking, drain and rinse beans. Set aside to drain further.
When the white mushrooms are softened, add garlic and spices to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp minced garlic
3 tbsp chili powder
1 tbsp cumin, ground
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Crumble tempeh into the pot, then add drained beans, tomatoes, broth, frozen pepper strips, and sugar. Stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (8 oz) pkg tempeh
2 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes
2 cups mushroom broth
1 (14 oz) bag frozen pepper strips
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Once the shitake mushrooms are rehydrated, drain, reserving the liquid. Roughly chop mushrooms, then add to the pot along with reserved liquid. Stir to combine and cover with a lid.
Place chili in the oven (it doesn't need to be boiling) and bake until the flavors have blended, about 1 hour. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide chili between bowls, then top with guacamole and shredded cheese. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup guacamole
1 cup vegan shredded cheese
